document: UAE Fire & Life Safety Code of Practice (CDGH-OP-25), September 2018; with DBC 2021 K.10.5 and K.9.4

rules.clause: DBC K.10.5.2; FLSC Ch.8 Table 8.13 item 26
rules.title: Smoke detection and alarm system
rules.requirement: Every villa / townhouse has a smoke detection and alarm system (wired per Ch.8 Section 4.3, or wireless per Section 4.11).

rules.title: Detectors in bedrooms, living rooms and corridors
rules.requirement: Bedroom: sounder-based smoke detector; living room: smoke detector; corridor: smoke detector.

rules.title: Closed kitchen detector
rules.requirement: Closed kitchen: detector listed for kitchens, or a heat detector.

rules.title: Open kitchen detector
rules.requirement: Open kitchen: listed kitchen detector, or heat detector plus a smoke detector 3 m from the counter in the living room, or a listed kitchen multisensor.

rules.title: Fire alarm panel location
rules.requirement: The fire alarm control panel or monitoring panel is located near the front door.

rules.clause: DBC K.10.5.2; FLSC Table 8.13 item 26 iv
rules.title: Outdoor audio-visual notification
rules.requirement: Audio-visual notification devices outside the villa, visible from the common approach road.

rules.title: Hassantuk connection
rules.requirement: The villa fire alarm system is connected to DCD control centres through Hassantuk for Homes.
needs: fire alarm system with Hassantuk flag

rules.title: Sprinklers and hose reels threshold
rules.requirement: Sprinklers in every room and hose reels are required when the ground floor GA > 1,500 m2 (or a basement GA > 1,500 m2).

rules.title: Primary means of escape
rules.requirement: Every sleeping room and every living area has a primary means of escape: a door, stair or ramp giving unobstructed travel to the outside.

rules.clause: FLSC Ch.3 Table 3.27 item 2 i, iv
rules.title: Secondary means of escape
rules.requirement: Every sleeping room and living area also has a secondary means of escape (not required if the villa is sprinklered): a remote door / stair / ramp, a passage through an adjacent non-lockable space, a roof route, or an operable escape window.

rules.clause: FLSC Ch.3 Table 3.27 item 2 iv d
rules.title: Escape window size
rules.requirement: Escape window on an exterior wall: >= 510 mm wide, >= 610 mm high, clear opening >= 0.53 m2, bottom <= 6,100 mm above finished ground.

rules.title: Two exits for large floors
rules.requirement: Where any floor of the villa exceeds 400 m2, two primary means of escape remote from each other are provided.

rules.title: Door hardware
rules.requirement: Bathroom doors openable from outside in an emergency when locked; closet latches openable from inside; no locking that impedes egress while occupied.

rules.title: Hallway width (FLSC)
rules.requirement: Hallway >= 915 mm wide with clear headroom >= 2,030 mm (DBC K-13 at 1.0 m is stricter and governs).

rules.title: Kitchen fire extinguisher
rules.requirement: Home kitchen: one multipurpose dry-powder extinguisher (2.5 kg) inside the kitchen next to the exit door.

rules.title: LPG cylinders
rules.requirement: LPG cylinders are not permitted indoors (unless DCD agrees; then FLSC Ch.11 Table 11.2).
